blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Industrial risk-control systems typically rely on structured-data models for efficient prediction, yet substantial valuable information remains embedded in unstructured long text. Extracting this information through manual feature engineering is labor-intensive, while requiring a large language model (LLM) to process every real-time input may not meet practical deployment requirements. To address this challenge, we propose LLM-BlockFE, an LLM-guided offline feature construction framework that converts long text into executable feature programs, thereby avoiding LLM calls during online inference. LLM-BlockFE constructs feature programs by incrementally appending immutable code blocks and evaluates candidate features using a downstream model. To address the tendency of conventional greedy search to become trapped in suboptimal solutions, our method introduces a block-level rollback mechanism based on depth-calibrated credit allocation and advances multiple independent search trajectories in an interleaved manner, reducing redundant exploration by sharing fixed descriptions of each trajectory's exploration direction. After the search, the resulting programs are frozen and deployed to extract structured features for downstream prediction models. Across two public and two private datasets, LLM-BlockFE achieves absolute AUC improvements of 0.0069 to 0.0358 over the strongest baseline on each dataset in the full-dataset comparison. Post-launch monitoring across five deployed financial risk-control applications shows absolute KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over the existing manually designed strategy.
blocks.zh: 工业风险控制系统通常依靠结构化数据模型进行高效预测,但大量有价值的信息仍嵌入无结构的长文本中。 通过人工特性工程提取这种信息是劳动密集型的,同时要求大型语言模型(LLM)处理每一个实时输入可能无法满足实际部署要求. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议LLM-BlockFE,这是一个LLM制导的离线功能构建框架,将长文本转换为可执行的功能程序,从而避免在线推论期间LLM调用. LLM-BlockFE通过递增附加不可变的代码块构建特征程序,并使用下游模型评价候选特征. 为了解决传统贪婪的搜索被困在不理想解决方案中的倾向,我们的方法引入了基于深度校准信用分配的区块级回滚机制,并以互离方式推进多个独立搜索轨迹,通过共享每个轨道探索方向的固定描述来减少冗余探索. 搜索后,产生的程序被冻结并部署,为下游预测模型提取结构化特征. 在两个公共数据集和两个私人数据集中,LLM-BlockFE在全数据集比较中,每个数据集最强基线的绝对AUC改进率为0.0069至0.0358。 对5个已部署的财务风险控制应用程序的发射后监测显示,KS比现有人工设计的战略有0.02至1.56个百分点的绝对改进。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: In high-stakes industrial applications such as financial risk control, predictive models must not only achieve high accuracy but also meet stringent constraints on inference latency and maintainability. Gradient-boosted tree models for structured data, such as XGBoost ( Chen and Guestrin, 2016 ) and LightGBM ( Ke et al., 2017 ) , therefore remain widely used in industry because of their computational efficiency and seamless compatibility with existing business systems. Meanwhile, as business operations become more complex, unstructured long texts, such as transcripts of customer service calls, are increasingly becoming an important source of business information ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) . These texts contain rich information about user behavior, actual intent, and latent risk signals, but their unstructured form makes them difficult to use directly with commonly adopted structured-data models ( Fujii et al., 2022 ) . Consequently, extracting effective features from raw long text has become a key bottleneck in industrial modeling.
blocks.zh: 在金融风险控制等高吸收量的工业应用中,预测模型不仅必须达到高精度,而且还必须满足对推断延迟性和可维持性的严格限制. XGBoost (Chen and Guestrin, 2016)和LightGBM (Ke等, 2017)等结构化数据的渐变-起步树模型,因此因其计算效率和与现有商业系统的无缝相容性而仍然被广泛应用于业界. 同时,随着业务运作日益复杂,客户服务电话记录等无结构的长文正日益成为业务信息的重要来源(Jiang等,2023年). 这些文本包含关于用户行为、实际意图和潜在风险信号的丰富信息,但其无结构形式使其难以直接与通常采用的有结构的数据模型使用(Fujii等,2022年)。 因此,从原始长文中提取出有效特征已成为工业建模的一个关键瓶颈。

blocks.en: At present, enterprises primarily rely on domain experts to design cleaning rules, text parsing logic, and feature computation programs, and then standardize the extracted outputs for use by downstream models. Variations such as colloquial language, omitted expressions, paraphrases, and cross-sentence semantics require manually designed parsing logic and feature rules to be continually extended and maintained. Existing text representation methods also have limitations: shallow features such as TF–IDF have limited capacity to represent contextual semantics. Dense vectors produced by pretrained models are difficult to interpret directly. Although long-sequence encoders can model long text context, their outputs typically require further processing to form structured feature columns with clear semantics ( Balek et al., 2025 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ) . In addition, automated feature engineering methods that take existing structured feature columns as input primarily search for transformations and combinations of variables, without directly addressing feature construction from raw long text ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 目前,企业主要依靠域专家设计清洁规则,文本解析逻辑,和特征计算程序,然后将提取出的产出标准化,供下游模型使用. 诸如口语、省略的表达语、解释语和跨句语义等变化要求手动设计的解析逻辑和特征规则不断得到扩展和维护。 现有文字表述方法也有局限性: TF-IDF等浅显特征代表上下文语义的能力有限. 由被预先训练的模型所生成的敏捷向量难以直接解释. 虽然长序编码器可以建模长文本上下文,但其输出通常需要进一步处理,以形成结构化特征列并带有明确的语义(Balek等,2025;Beltagy等,2020;Zaheer等,2020.). 此外,将现有结构化特征列作为输入的自动化特征工程方法主要用于查找变数的转换和组合,而不直接从原始长文本处理特征构建(张等,2023).

blocks.en: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong natural language understanding and code generation capabilities, offering a new technical approach to feature engineering ( Novikov et al., 2025 ; Shojaee et al., 2025 ) . Some studies use LLMs to generate feature transformation code for existing tabular columns ( Abhyankar et al., 2025 ) , while others use LLMs to extract features with clear semantics from text ( Malberg et al., 2024 ) . For methods that rely on an LLM to generate feature values for individual samples, continuously arriving text inputs that require immediate scoring still need LLM inference, even when the feature definitions are established offline. This increases the latency and computational overhead of online feature extraction, placing pressure on industrial deployments with high concurrency.
blocks.zh: 近年来,大型语言模型(LLMs)展现出强大的自然语言理解和代码生成能力,为地物工程提供了新的技术方法(Novikov等,2025;Shojaee等,2025.). 一些研究使用LLMs为现有的表列生成特征转换代码(Abhyankar等,2025年),而其他研究则使用LLMs从文本中取出有清晰语义的特征(Malberg等,2024年). 对于依赖LLM为单个样本生成特征值的方法,需要立即打分的连续到来文本输入仍然需要LLM推论,即使特征定义是离线确定的. 这增加了在线地物提取的延迟性和计算间接费用,对货币高的工业部署造成压力。

blocks.en: To address these deployment constraints, we propose LLM-BlockFE , which formulates long text feature construction as the offline synthesis of executable feature programs. Unlike approaches that directly invoke an LLM for end-to-end prediction or per-sample feature extraction, LLM-BlockFE uses the LLM’s semantic reasoning and code generation capabilities only during the offline stage to discover features and write the corresponding extraction programs. The resulting structured features are then provided to a downstream supervised model. This design allows the feature logic to be reviewed and maintained in code form and requires no LLM calls during the online stage.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些部署限制,我们提议LLM-BlockFE ,它提出长文本特征构建,作为可执行特征程序的离线合成. 与直接引用LLM进行端到端预测或每样特征提取的方法不同,LLM-BlockFE仅在下行阶段使用LLM的语义推理和代码生成能力来发现特征并写入相应的提取程序. 由此产生的结构特征随后提供给下游监督模型。 这种设计使得功能逻辑能够以代码形式被审查和维护,并且不需要在线阶段的LLM呼叫.

blocks.en: Specifically, LLM-BlockFE constructs scalar feature extraction programs for long text and uses Incremental Program Search to generate a feature set whose members jointly improve downstream model performance. During the search, our method introduces a block-level rollback mechanism based on depth-calibrated credit allocation and advances multiple independent feature construction trajectories in an interleaved manner, reducing redundant exploration by sharing fixed descriptions of each trajectory’s exploration direction. In deployment, the business system only needs to execute the finalized feature program code and its lightweight dependencies, with zero online LLM calls. Across five real-world financial risk-control applications, post-launch monitoring shows absolute KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over the existing manually designed strategy across all 15 application-month comparisons. In addition, the offline evaluation results show that our method outperforms the strongest competing baseline on AUC values across all four datasets.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,LLM-BlockFE为长文本构建了scalar特征提取程序,并使用递增程序搜索来生成一个特征集,其成员共同提高下游模型性能. 在搜索过程中,我们的方法引入了基于深度校正信用分配的区块级回滚机制,并以互出式方式推进多个独立地物构造轨迹,通过共享每个轨道探索方向的固定描述来减少冗余探索. 在部署中,业务系统只需要执行已定稿的特性程序代码及其轻量级依赖性,没有在线LLM呼叫. 在5个实际世界金融风险控制应用程序中,发射后监测显示,在所有15个应用月的比较中,KS绝对比现有手工设计战略提高0.02至1.56个百分点。 此外,离线评价结果表明,我们的方法的绩效超过了所有四个数据集中最强的AUC值竞争基准。

blocks.en: The contributions of this paper are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 本文件的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We propose LLM-BlockFE for long text feature engineering, formulating feature construction as the offline synthesis of executable programs. We design a protocol for complete program generation and immutable block-level updates, providing explicit operational boundaries for incremental construction and local rollback. The resulting programs are used directly for online feature extraction, without requiring online LLM calls. • We propose a depth-calibrated credit-guided backtracking mechanism that separately evaluates the current program’s predictive performance and its opportunity for further expansion. Based on a node’s recent expansion outcomes and historical baselines at the same depth, the mechanism determines whether to continue expansion or restore the parent program, reducing the dependence of single-path search on early choices. • Experiments on multiple public and private datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines. Deployment and online evaluation in five real-world financial risk-control applications further validate the improvements that LLM-BlockFE brings to downstream predictive performance and its value for industrial applications.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Traditional Long Text Representation and Feature Engineering. Traditional long text feature engineering typically transforms raw text into representations that can be processed by models. Common approaches include using TF-IDF to encode terms and their frequencies, extracting manually defined attributes as text statistics, and further compressing sparse term representations using dimensionality reduction methods such as SVD ( Qi et al., 2024 ) . Another line of work uses pretrained language models to produce contextual representations. Long-sequence Transformers such as Longformer and BigBird extend the text lengths that models can process, and their encoded outputs can also be pooled to form document-level representations ( Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 传统长文字表现和特色工程. 传统的长文本特征工程一般会将原始文本转化为可以被模型处理的表示. 常见的方法包括使用TF-IDF来编码术语及其频率,取出手动定义的属性作为文本统计,并使用SVD(Qi等,2024)等维度还原方法来进一步压缩稀有的术语表示. 另一行工作采用预先训练的语言模型来制作背景表述. Longformer和BigBird等长序变换器延长了模型可以处理的文本长度,其编码输出也可以集合,形成文件级别的表示(Beltagy等,2020;Zaheer等,2020.).

blocks.en: Although the above methods can be used for text prediction, they remain insufficient to meet industrial requirements for feature controllability and interpretability. Traditional methods based on terms or manually defined rules have limited adaptability to variations in expression, such as colloquial language and omissions. Although pretrained language models can capture context, their outputs are typically high-dimensional dense vectors with no directly interpretable semantics, and require additional representation processing and inference computation. Therefore, the problem of automatically constructing compact, interpretable, and easily deployable structured features from raw long text remains unaddressed directly.
blocks.zh: 虽然上述方法可用于文字预测,但是仍然不足以满足特性可控性和可解释性的工业要求. 以术语或人工定义的规则为基础的传统方法对表达方式的变化的适应性有限,如口语和省略. 虽然被预先训练的语言模型可以捕捉上下文,但其输出一般是高维密向量而无可直接解释的语义,需要额外的表达处理和推论计算. 因此,从原始长文中自动构建紧凑、可解释和易于部署的结构特征的问题仍未直接得到解决。

blocks.en: Automated Feature Engineering. Automated feature engineering typically starts from existing structured variables and searches for feature transformations that benefit downstream prediction. Methods such as OpenFE generate and select tabular features from a predefined operator space ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) . Recent work further draws on the semantic knowledge of LLMs to propose candidate transformations. CAAFE generates feature engineering code based on dataset descriptions and table columns ( Hollmann et al., 2023 ) , while OCTree converts predictive feedback expressed by a decision tree into natural-language reasoning to iteratively refine feature-generation rules ( Nam et al., 2024 ) . LLM-FE formulates tabular feature transformation as program search and iteratively optimizes candidate programs through evolutionary-style search ( Abhyankar et al., 2025 ) . FAMOSE, in turn, adopts a ReAct-based agent workflow for feature discovery ( Burghardt et al., 2026 ) . Furthermore, NSR-Boost corrects the prediction residuals of industrial legacy models by gradually generating and verifying executable expert programs ( Dai et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 自动化地物工程. 自动化地物工程一般从现有的结构变量开始,并寻找有利于下游预测的地物转化. OpenFE 等方法生成并选择预定义操作员空间的表式特征(张等,2023. 最近的工作进一步利用法学硕士的语义知识,提出候选人的转变。 CAAFE基于数据集描述和表列生成特征工程代码(Holmann等,2023年),而OCTree则将决策树表达的预测反馈转化为自然语言推理来迭代地完善特征生成规则(Nam等,2024年). LLM-FE通过程序搜索来制定表格特征转换,并通过进化式搜索来迭代优化候选程序(Abhyankar等,2025年). FAMOSE则通过基于ReAct的代理工作流程来进行特征发现(Burghardt等,2026年). 此外,NSR-Boost通过逐步生成和核查可执行的专家方案(Dai等人,2026年),纠正了工业遗留模型的预测残余。

blocks.en: However, these methods primarily search over existing tabular columns and their descriptions, with the central task of transforming or combining structured variables. This paper instead focuses on unstructured long text inputs: the system must construct features from the text content that can be used directly by tabular models, rather than merely transforming existing tabular columns.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些方法主要搜索现有的表格栏及其说明,其核心任务是转换或合并结构化变量。 本文则侧重于无结构的长文本输入:系统必须从文本内容中构建出可以被表格模型直接使用的特征,而不只是转换现有的表格列.

blocks.en: LLM-Based Feature Engineering for Unstructured Text. Recently, several studies have begun to explore feature engineering for long text using the semantic knowledge of LLMs. FELIX uses an LLM to generate interpretable features for text samples and applies them to downstream classification ( Malberg et al., 2024 ) . Balek et al. study the extraction of a small number of semantic features from scientific literature, showing that these features can support text classification while remaining interpretable ( Balek et al., 2025 ) . Barlier et al. investigate feature generation for joint prediction from text and tabular data ( Barlier and Skrlj, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: LLM基于无结构文字的地物工程. 最近,一些研究开始利用LLMs的语义知识来探索长文本的特征工程. FELIX使用LLM生成文本样本的可解释特征并应用于下游分类(Malberg等,2024.). 巴列克等编. 研究从科学文献中取出少量语义特征,表明这些特征可以支持文本分类,而同时仍然可以解释(Balek等,2025.). Barlier等人利用文本和表格数据调查特征生成情况(Barlier和Skrlj,2026年)。

blocks.en: However, in these methods, candidate feature values still need to be extracted or assigned by an LLM for individual text samples. Batch processing or offline precomputation can mitigate this overhead, but for new samples that arrive continuously and require immediate scoring, feature extraction still incurs additional inference costs and latency, and creates a dependency on the serving infrastructure. In contrast, LLM-BlockFE uses an LLM to construct feature programs offline. After deployment, the system generates features by directly executing the frozen programs, without calling an LLM, thereby enabling fast inference.
blocks.zh: 然而,在这些方法中,候选特征值仍需由LLM提取或指定用于单个文本样本. 批量加工或离线预计算可以减轻这种间接费用,但对于不断抵达并需要立即打分的新样品,抽取地物仍然需要额外的推论费用和耐久性,并造成对服务基础设施的依赖。 相形之下,LLM-BlockFE使用LLM来构建离线的特征程序. 部署后,系统通过直接执行被冻结的程序生成特性,而无需调用LLM,从而能够快速推论.

blocks.en: Figure 1. Overview of LLM-BlockFE, which searches for text feature programs offline and executes the selected programs for online prediction.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , the LLM-BlockFE architecture consists of three tightly coupled components. First, the system generates a complete candidate program and extracts the added code block using predefined markers, enabling incremental updates while keeping existing code unchanged. Parameters within the added block are then locally tuned through Bayesian optimization. Second, a depth-calibrated credit mechanism evaluates the relative opportunity of obtaining an acceptable child through further expansion of the current program node, guiding continued expansion or dynamic backtracking. Finally, guided by fixed exploration directions, the system advances multiple search trajectories asynchronously in an interleaved manner and shares direction descriptions to reduce redundant exploration. After the search, the system collects and freezes the best programs from all trajectories for online feature extraction, without requiring online LLM calls.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,LLM-BlockFE架构由三个紧密相接的组件组成. 首先,系统生成一个完整的候选程序,并使用预定义的标记来取出所添加的代码块,允许增量更新,同时保持了现有代码不变. 新增块内的参数然后通过贝叶斯优化本地调取. 其次,深度校正的信用机制通过进一步扩大目前的方案节点,指导继续扩展或动态回溯,来评价获得可接受的孩子的相对机会. 最后,在固定勘探方向的指导下,系统以互出式同步推进多条搜索轨迹,并共享方向描述以减少冗余勘探. 搜索后,系统收集并冻结所有轨迹中最好的程序进行在线特征提取,而无需在线LLM呼叫.

blocks.en: To maintain coherence in the overall program logic while allowing local updates to be reversed, LLM-BlockFE adopts a program update mechanism based on “complete generation and incremental extraction”, as shown in Figure 2 . Directly requesting an isolated code addition from the LLM can readily lead to mismatches, such as variable name conflicts, calls to undefined interfaces, or semantic discontinuities with existing code, because of the model’s limited awareness of the surrounding program. LLM-BlockFE therefore uses the complete program as the unit of generation. The LLM receives P n P_{n} , a very small set of text samples 𝒟 llm ⊂ 𝒟 train \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{llm}}\subset\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{train}} , the task description, callable tools, and previous generation summaries. It generates complete candidate code, marks the added region using predefined markers ( <BEGIN>...<END> ), and provides a summary of the current round for subsequent iterations. The system then precisely extracts the added code block b b using a regular expression, constructs the candidate program P n ′ = P n ⊕ b P_{n}^{\prime}=P_{n}\oplus b , and strictly checks whether the existing code outside the markers has changed. Any candidate that impermissibly modifies the original code is rejected. Generating with the full program context promotes syntactic and logical compatibility between the new and existing code, while block-level extraction preserves clear boundaries between them and provides the basis for subsequent local backtracking.

blocks.en: 4.2. Depth-Calibrated Credit-Guided Backtracking

blocks.en: The previous subsection introduced candidate code-block construction, but the append-only constraint does not, by itself, determine how the program space is explored. If the search always expands along the current path, blocks accepted early may constrain subsequent exploration. NSR-Boost uses an annealed threshold to allow small performance decreases early in the search, but still uses the current program as the starting point for subsequent iterations ( Dai et al., 2026 ) . LLM-BlockFE introduces depth-calibrated credit-guided backtracking, using the current node’s expansion opportunity to determine whether to continue the search or restore the parent program to explore an alternative branch ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Parsert and Polgreen, 2024 ) .

blocks.en: 4.3. Asynchronous Multi-Program Construction
blocks.zh: 4.3. 同步多方案建设

blocks.en: To construct multiple text feature programs, LLM-BlockFE advances multiple search trajectories in an interleaved manner. Each trajectory starts from the initial program P 0 P_{0} and separately maintains its current search path, code-block history, rollback state, and best-program archive. Once a trajectory’s first code block is accepted, the LLM establishes a fixed exploration direction based on the feature semantics of that block. The system can then initiate new trajectories when the budget permits, without waiting for existing trajectories to complete their searches.

Trajectories share only descriptions of their exploration directions. When generating a candidate code block, the LLM continues feature construction based on the current program and fixed direction of its own trajectory, while referring to the direction descriptions of other trajectories to avoid repeatedly exploring the same targets ( Han et al., 2025 ) . The program code, best paths, and feature outputs of other trajectories are excluded from the generation context of the current trajectory. The fixed direction constrains the primary exploration target but allows different trajectories to use the same keywords or tools.
blocks.zh: 轨迹只分享对其勘探方向的描述. 在生成候选代码块时,LLM继续基于当前程序和自身轨迹的固定方向进行特征构建,同时提及其他轨迹的方向描述来避免重复探索同一种目标(Han等,2025. 程序代码,最佳路径,以及其它轨迹的特征输出被排除在当前轨迹的生成上下文之外. 固定方向会限制主勘探目标,但允许不同的道由使用相同的关键词或工具.

blocks.en: Each trajectory follows the candidate construction and evaluation procedure in Section 4.1, independently performing initial text AUC screening, local Bayesian optimization, and downstream AUC evaluation. Downstream evaluation uses only the pre-existing structured features and the program output of the current trajectory, excluding features from other trajectories. Accepted code blocks are added to the current path. When the resulting downstream AUC exceeds the trajectory’s historical maximum, its best-program archive is updated. Rollback changes only the current path. It neither deletes the archived best program nor changes the fixed exploration direction.
blocks.zh: 每个轨迹都遵循第4.1节中候选的构建和评价程序,独立进行初始文本AUC筛选,当地巴耶斯优化,下游AUC评价. 下游评价只使用原有的结构化特征和当前轨迹的程序输出,不包括其他轨迹中的特征. 接受的代码块被添加到当前路径中. 当产生的下游AUC超过轨迹历史极限时,其最佳方案存档会被更新. 回滚只更改当前路径 。 它既不删除存档的最佳程序,也不改变固定的勘探方向.

blocks.en: Candidate generation and evaluation can run concurrently across trajectories, while candidate processing and state updates within each trajectory proceed sequentially. After the search, the system freezes the best programs saved by all trajectories and jointly trains the final downstream model using their outputs together with the pre-existing structured variables.
blocks.zh: 候选人的生成和评价可以同时跨出轨迹,而每个轨迹内的候选人处理和状态更新则相继进行。 搜索后,系统会冻结所有轨迹所保存的最佳程序,并联合培训最终下游模型,同时使用其输出以及先前存在的结构变量.

blocks.en: 5.1. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1. 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate the proposed method on two public and two private datasets, using models trained only on structured attributes as baselines to measure the incremental gains from text features. The public datasets include CFPB-Timely, constructed from the CFPB Consumer Complaint Database ( Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, 2026 ) , with complaint narratives as text inputs and whether the company responded in a timely manner as the prediction target. It contains 200,000 samples and seven structured features. The other public dataset is a news veracity dataset constructed from the GossipCop subset of FakeNewsNet ( Shu et al., 2020 ) , with news article text as input alongside structured features such as the number of images. The private datasets, Remark and Report, originate from Qfin Holdings’ credit risk-control applications and contain de-identified text records with corresponding risk labels. Remark comprises remarks made by contacts about target users, whereas Report comprises call records between customer-service agents and users.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们在两个公共数据集和两个私人数据集上评价拟议方法,仅将结构化属性培训的模型作为基线,以衡量文本特征带来的增量收益。 公共数据集包括CFPB-Timely,由CFPB消费者投诉数据库(消费者金融保护局,2026年)所建,以投诉叙事为文本投入,公司是否及时回应作为预测目标. 它包含20万个样本和7个结构化特征. 另一套公共数据集是从假新闻网的GossipCop子集(Shu等,2020年)所构建的新闻真实性数据集,新闻文章文本与图像数量等结构化特征一起被输入. 私人数据集Remark和Report来源于Qfin Holdings的信用风险控制应用程序并包含有相应风险标签的去识别文本记录. 说明包括联系人对目标用户的评论,而报告则包括客户服务代理和用户之间的通话记录。

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol. We use AUC to evaluate predictive performance. Each dataset is divided into 60% training, 20% validation, and 20% test sets. We conduct independent experiments using five random seeds and report the mean results.
blocks.zh: 评估协议。 我们使用AUC来评估预测性能. 每个数据集分为60%的培训,20%的验证,20%的测试集. 我们使用五个随机种子进行独立实验,并报告平均结果。

blocks.en: Baselines. Conventional text representation methods include TF–IDF, TF–IDF + SVD, statistical text features (TextStats), and dense embeddings (Embedding). Automated feature engineering methods include OpenFE ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , CAAFE ( Hollmann et al., 2023 ) , OCTree ( Nam et al., 2024 ) , and LLM-FE ( Abhyankar et al., 2025 ) . During feature engineering, OCTree uses TextStats extracted from long text as input, while LLM-FE and CAAFE take long text directly as input. We also include FELIX ( Malberg et al., 2024 ) as an LLM-based text feature extraction baseline. Due to the cost of per-sample LLM calls, we compare its performance and latency only on subsets of Remark and CFPB-Timely. Except for an additional TF–IDF + Logistic Regression (LR) comparison, all baselines use XGBoost with hyperparameters optimized via Bayesian optimization as the downstream predictor.
blocks.zh: 基线。 常规文本表达方法包括TF-IDF,TF-IDF + SVD,统计文本特征(TextStats)和密集嵌入(Embedding). 自动化地物工程方法包括:OpenFE(张等,2023年),CAAFE(Holmann等,2023年),OCTree(Nam等,2024年)和LLM-FE(Abhyankar等,2025年). 在特性工程期间,OCTree使用从长文本中提取出来的文件Stats作为输入,而LLM-FE和CAAFE则直接使用长文本作为输入. 我们还将FELIX(Malberg等,2024年)作为基于LLM的文本特征提取基准. 由于每例LLM呼叫的成本,我们只比较其性能和耐用性与Remark和CFPB-Timely的子集. 除了额外的TF-IDF + Logistic Regression(LR)比较外,所有基线都使用有超参数的XGBoost作为下游预测器,通过贝叶斯优化优化.

blocks.en: 5.2. Offline Performance and Efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.2. 离线性能和效率

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the classification performance of LLM-BlockFE and the baseline methods across four datasets. Except for TF–IDF + LR, which uses logistic regression, all feature engineering baselines use XGBoost as the downstream prediction model. LLM-BlockFE achieves the best performance on all datasets, with AUCs of 0.6804, 0.5545, 0.8881, and 0.9472 on the private datasets Remark and Report and the public datasets CFPB-Timely and GossipCop, respectively. These correspond to improvements of 0.0358, 0.0209, 0.0152, and 0.0069 over the strongest baseline on each dataset. These results confirm the method’s generalization ability and superior performance on both private data and general public long text tasks.
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了LLM-BlockFE的分类性能和四个数据集的基准方法. 除TF-IDF + LR使用物流回归外,所有特征工程基线均以XGBoost作为下游预测模型. LLM-BlockFE在所有数据集上都实现了最佳性能,AUC分别为0.6804,0.5545,0.8881和0.9472,分别是私人数据集Remark和Report以及公共数据集CFPB-Timely和GossipCop. 这与每个数据集最强基线的0.0358、0.0209、0.0152和0.0069的改进情况相对应。 这些结果证实了该方法在私人数据和一般公共长文本任务上的通俗化能力和优异性能.

blocks.en: Comparing the different baseline paradigms reveals that LLM-based feature engineering methods significantly outperform conventional statistical methods and traditional AutoFE methods overall on the private risk-control datasets, where noise is greater and informative signals are more subtle and complex. This finding clearly demonstrates the stronger capabilities of LLMs to extract deeper semantics and uncover implicit associations in noisy long text. Among the LLM-based methods, LLM-BlockFE further achieves the best performance across all datasets through incremental code-block evolution and credit-guided dynamic backtracking. Moreover, unlike methods that rely on real-time online LLM calls, LLM-BlockFE moves the entire process of constructing complex feature programs to the offline stage. Online deployment requires only sequential execution of the frozen feature code, incurring zero computational or latency overhead from online LLM calls.
blocks.zh: 比较不同的基线范式后发现,基于LLM的特征工程方法在总体上大大超过传统的统计方法和私人风险控制数据集上的传统AutoFE方法,这些数据集的噪音更大,信息信号更微妙和复杂. 这一结论清楚地表明,LLMs更有能力在吵闹的长文中提取更深层次的语义并发现隐含的联系。 在基于LLM的方法中,LLM-BlockFE通过递增的代码块演化和以信用为导的动态回溯来进一步实现所有数据集的最佳性能. 此外,与依赖实时在线LLM调用的方法不同,LLM-BlockFE将构建复杂功能程序的整个过程移动到离线舞台. 在线部署只要求连续执行被冻结的地物代码,从在线LLM电话中产生零计算或延迟的间接费用.

blocks.en: Compared with FELIX, a strong baseline that also focuses on efficiency, LLM-BlockFE achieves higher AUC while reducing inference latency by orders of magnitude. This substantial advantage stems from complete architectural decoupling: LLM-BlockFE confines the LLM’s complex logical understanding and feature search processes entirely to the offline stage. Online deployment requires only sequential execution of the frozen programs for feature extraction, eliminating the substantial computational overhead and latency bottleneck of online LLM inference for individual samples.
blocks.zh: 与同样注重效率的强基线FELIX相比,LLM-BlockFE实现了更高的AUC,同时以数量级来降低推论延迟. 这种实质性优势源于完整的建筑脱钩:LLM-BlockFE将LLM复杂的逻辑理解和特征搜索过程完全局限在离线舞台上. 在线部署只要求按顺序执行被冻结的功能提取程序,消除在线LLM推断对单个样本的大量计算间接费用和延迟瓶颈。

blocks.en: 5.3. Production Deployment and Post-Launch Impact
blocks.zh: 5.3. 生产部署和损失后的影响

blocks.en: Figure 4. Online performance of LLM-BlockFE across five production risk-control applications. The figure compares monthly KS values for LLM-BlockFE and the existing manually designed strategy on the same online samples from September to November 2025, covering 2,694,342 real-world users.
blocks.zh: 图 4. LLM-BlockFE在5个生产风险控制应用程序中的在线性能。 这一数字比较了LLM-BlockFE的每月KS值和2025年9月至11月在同一在线样本上的现有人工设计策略,覆盖了2,694,342个现实世界用户.

blocks.en: LLM-BlockFE has been deployed in five real-world financial risk-control applications. During online inference, the system executes feature programs generated and frozen offline, without calling an LLM. Because this feature engineering process does not alter the original structured data, the production system can compute results for two approaches in parallel on exactly the same online samples: one retains the existing manually designed strategy, while the other uses text features generated by LLM-BlockFE. Both approaches use the same samples, labels, structured features, downstream model, and other business strategies. Their performance differences therefore reflect the impact of changing the text feature approach.
blocks.zh: LLM-BlockFE已部署在5个现实世界的金融风险控制应用中. 在在线推导期间,系统执行生成并被冻结的功能程序,而不调用LLM. 由于这个特征工程过程并不改变原有的结构化数据,生产系统可以在完全相同的在线样本上平行地计算出两种方法的结果:一种保留了现有的手动设计的策略,而另一种则使用由LLM-BlockFE生成的文本特征. 两种方法都使用相同的样本,标签,结构化特征,下游模式等商业战略. 因此,它们的绩效差异反映了改变文本特征方法的影响。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows the monthly KS values of both approaches across the five applications from September to November 2025, covering 2,694,342 real users. Across all 15 application–month comparisons, the LLM-BlockFE approach achieves higher KS than the existing manually designed strategy, with absolute improvements of 0.02–1.56 percentage points. These production results show that, with all other inputs and modeling procedures held fixed, incorporating text features generated by LLM-BlockFE yields higher discrimination in all five risk-control applications.
blocks.zh: 图4显示2025年9月至11月五个应用程序的两种方法的每月KS值,涵盖2,694,342名实际用户。 在所有15个应用月的比较中,LLM-BlockFE方法实现了高于现有人工设计的策略的KS,绝对改进了0.02-1.56个百分点. 这些生产结果表明,由于所有其他投入和建模程序都固定不变,纳入LLM-BlockFE生成的文字特性,在所有五个风险控制应用程序中都会产生更严重的歧视。

blocks.en: The system’s practical business value is further validated through real-world online A/B testing. In an online evaluation covering approximately RMB 1 billion in loan disbursements, the treatment group significantly reduced the bad debt rate from 8.0% to 7.7% while keeping the number of approved applicants unchanged. The company has developed more than 200 effective feature chains using this framework, achieving comprehensive coverage of nearly all customer segments. From an engineering perspective, feedback indicates that the deployed feature computation pipelines incur very low online overhead and require no GPUs, demonstrating strong potential for broader industrial adoption.
blocks.zh: 通过现实世界的在线A/B测试进一步验证了该系统的实际业务价值。 在覆盖约10亿元人民币贷款支付额的在线评价中,治疗组将不良债务利率从8.0%大幅降至7.7%,同时将批准的申请人数量保持不变. 公司利用这个框架开发了200多条有效的地物链,实现了对几乎所有客户部分的全面覆盖. 从工程学的角度来看,反馈表明,部署的特性计算管道的在线间接费用非常低,不需要GPU,这表明了更广泛的工业采用的巨大潜力。

blocks.en: 5.4. Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.4. 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 2. Ablation study on the Remark dataset. AUC Drop denotes the absolute performance decrease relative to the full method.
blocks.zh: 页:1 2. 关于Remark数据集的研究。 联合自卫军 投放表示相对于全方法的绝对性能下降.

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes the ablation results on Remark. Each setting was evaluated over a separate set of five independent runs, distinct from those used for the main comparison in Table 1 . The reported AUC is the mean across these runs. The complete method achieves an AUC of 0.6760, an absolute improvement of 0.0570 over Base-XGB. Removing any module reduces AUC, indicating that each design contributes to the final performance under the current experimental setting. Removing the downstream AUC gate has the largest impact: AUC drops to 0.6268, which is 0.0492 below the complete method and only 0.0078 above Base-XGB. This shows that even if a candidate program executes successfully and passes the initial text AUC screening and local parameter optimization, it may not provide a conditional gain to the downstream model. Evaluating the downstream AUC gain for each block helps filter out candidate programs that fail to improve predictive performance.
blocks.zh: 表2汇总了Remark的审结结果。 对每套环境分别进行了五套独立运行的评价,与表1主要比较所使用的不同。 据报的哥伦比亚联合自卫军是贯穿这些赛事的恶果。 全方法实现0.6760的AUC,比Base-XGB的绝对改进为0.0570. 删除任何模块都会降低AUC,表明每个设计都有助于当前实验设置下的最终性能. 拆除下游的AUC出入口影响最大:AUC下降至0.6268,低于全方法0.0492,仅高于Base-XGB0.0078. 这表明,即使一个候选程序成功执行并通过了初始文本AUC筛选和本地参数优化,它也可能不会为下游模型提供有条件的收益. 评估每个区块的下游AUC增益有助于筛选出无法改善预测性能的候选程序.

blocks.en: Ablations of the program construction and search mechanisms also demonstrate the roles of their respective components. Removing the append-only constraint reduces AUC to 0.6357, suggesting that restricting the scope of changes in each round and freezing accepted code blocks helps stabilize program construction. Removing Bayesian optimization reduces AUC to 0.6383, demonstrating the contribution of local parameter optimization to final predictive performance. For the search mechanism, disabling backtracking reduces AUC to 0.6470, indicating that unidirectional expansion is susceptible to constraints imposed by early choices. When credit guidance is removed, the system instead backtracks after a fixed threshold of three failures, and AUC drops to 0.6573. Removing depth calibration reduces AUC to 0.6640. These results indicate that credit guidance provides more effective backtracking decisions than a fixed failure threshold, while depth calibration further improves search outcomes on this dataset. Removing cross-program sharing yields an AUC of 0.6708. Although the decrease is relatively small, it still indicates an additional benefit from sharing exploration directions.
blocks.zh: 程序构建和搜索机制的缺失也显示了它们各自组成部分的作用. 取消附加-只限限制将AUC降低到0.6357,说明限制每个回合的修改范围并冻结接受的代码块有助于稳定程序构建. 删除贝叶斯优化将AUC降低到0.6383,表明本地参数优化对最终预测性能的贡献. 对于搜索机制,使回路失效会将AUC减少到0.6470,表明单向扩展容易受早期选择所施加的限制. 当信用指导被移除后,系统在3个故障的固定阈值后反向运行,而AUC则降至0.6573. 取出深度校正后将AUC降至0.6640. 这些结果表明,信用指导比固定故障阈值提供更有效的回溯跟踪决策,而深度校正则会进一步改善本数据集的搜索结果. 取消跨程序共享的AUC值为0.6708. 虽然减少幅度较小,但仍表明分享勘探方向会有额外好处。

blocks.en: 5.5. Generalization Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.5. 一般分析

blocks.en: Figure 5. Generalization of LLM-BlockFE across downstream models and generator LLMs on the Remark dataset.
blocks.zh: 图 5. 在Remark数据集上对LLM-BlockFE进行跨下游模型和发电机LLMs的通用.

blocks.en: Generalization across downstream models. Figure 5 (a) examines whether the features generated by LLM-BlockFE are effective across different downstream models. Incorporating the generated features improves test AUC for all four models. XGBoost and LightGBM achieve gains of 0.053 and 0.046, respectively, while logistic regression and MLP improve by 0.048 and 0.018. These gains span tree-based, linear, and neural models, suggesting that the generated features provide useful predictive information beyond a single model architecture. The variation in gains also indicates that downstream models differ in how effectively they exploit the generated features.
blocks.zh: 跨下游型号通俗化. 图5 (a) 研究LLM-BlockFE产生的特性在不同的下游模型中是否有效。 纳入生成的特性可以改进对所有四个模型的AUC测试。 XGBoost和LightGBM分别实现0.053和0.046的增益,而物流回归和MLP则提高了0.048和0.018. 这些增益跨越了基于树的,线性的,和神经模型,表明所生成的特征提供了超出单一模型架构的有用的预测信息. 收益的变化还表明,下游模型在如何有效利用所生成的特征方面有所不同。

blocks.en: Generalization across feature-generating LLMs. Figure 5 (b) evaluates the sensitivity of LLM-BlockFE to the choice of feature-generating LLM. Relative to the baseline AUC of 0.627 without LLM-BlockFE, using Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct, Qwen3.5-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , and DeepSeek-R1 ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) yields test AUCs of 0.680, 0.669, and 0.677, respectively, corresponding to improvements of 0.053, 0.042, and 0.050. All three generation models improve performance, indicating that the method’s effectiveness does not depend on a single generation model. The differences in gain magnitude nevertheless show that generator choice affects the final predictive performance.
blocks.zh: 图5 (b) 评估LLM-BlockFE对选择出自特征的LLM的敏感性。 相对于没有LLM-BlockFE,使用Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct,Qune3.5-27B的基准AUC0.627 (Quen Team, 2026),和DeepSeek-R1(DeepSeek-AI, 2025)的产量测试AUC分别是0.680,0.669和0.677,对应0.053,0.042和0.050的改进. 所有三种生成模型都提高了性能,表明方法的有效性并不依赖于单一生成模型. 然而,增量的差别表明,发电机的选择影响到最后的预测性能。

blocks.en: 5.6. Feature Contribution and Case Studies
blocks.zh: 5.6. 特征贡献和个案研究

blocks.en: To analyze the role of the textual features generated by LLM-BlockFE in downstream model predictions, Table 3 summarizes their mean absolute SHAP values and relative contribution shares ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) . On the private datasets Remark and Report, the generated textual features account for 41.4% and 61.1% of the total attribution, respectively. On the public datasets CFPB-Timely and GossipCop, the corresponding shares are 9.5% and 19.4%. These results indicate that, under the current experimental settings, the generated textual features account for substantial attribution shares in model predictions on the two private datasets. Together with the AUC improvements obtained by incorporating textual features in Table 1 , the model attribution analysis and predictive performance results support the effectiveness of the generated features, suggesting that LLM-BlockFE can construct complementary features from long text that are useful for downstream prediction.
blocks.zh: 为了分析LLM-BlockFE生成的文字特征在下游模型预测中的作用,表3总结了它们的平均绝对SHAP值和相对贡献股份(Lundberg and Lee, 2017. 在私人数据集Remark和Report上,生成的文字特性分别占归属总量的41.4%和61.1%. 在公共数据集CFPB-Timely和GossipCop上,相应的份额为9.5%和19.4%. 这些结果表明,在当前实验设置下,生成的文字特征在两个私人数据集的模型预测中占有相当大的归属份额. 模型归属分析和预测性能结果与通过将文字特征纳入表1而获得的AUC改进一道,支持生成的特性的有效性,表明LLM-BlockFE可以从长文字中构建出对下游预测有用的互补特征.

blocks.zh: 表3. LLM-BlockFE在数据集中生成的特性基于SHAP的贡献。

blocks.en: Figure 6. Case study of a deployed feature program on a real customer-service dialogue.
blocks.zh: 图6. 关于实际客户-服务对话的部署专题方案的个案研究。

blocks.en: To illustrate how the generated feature is computed, Figure 6 presents a dialogue excerpt, statistics for the full text, and the corresponding code snippet. The complete dialogue contains 57 turns and 1,647 characters across both speakers, with 32 occurrences of the specified discourse particles, yielding a normalized frequency of 0.0194. Rather than applying an adjustment directly based on the occurrence count, the code first divides the count by the text length and then compares the resulting frequency with a threshold. Because this sample’s frequency is below the threshold of 0.0629, the program follows the default branch and produces an adjustment of − 0.0775 -0.0775 , without activating the exponential adjustment branch. Thus, repeated occurrences of discourse particles do not necessarily trigger a stronger negative adjustment. Their effect depends on their frequency relative to the length of the full text. This example makes the relationship between text statistics, conditional logic, and the local numerical adjustment directly traceable.
blocks.zh: 为了说明如何计算生成的特性,图6提供了对话节录、全文统计和相应的代码片段。 完整的对话包含57个回合和1 647个两个发言者的字符,其中32个是特定话语颗粒,产生0.0194的正常频率。 代码不直接根据发生数进行调整,而是先将计数除以文字长度,再将由此产生的频率与阈值作比较. 由于这个样本的频率低于0.0629的阈值,程序遵循默认分支,并产生−0.0775-0.0775的调整,而未激活指数调整分支. 因此,反复出现言论粒子并不一定会引起更强烈的负面调整. 其效果取决于相对于全文长度的频率. 这个例子使得文本统计,条件逻辑,和本地数字调整之间的关系可以直接追踪.

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en: We propose LLM-BlockFE, which formulates feature construction from unstructured long text as an offline search for executable programs. The method builds feature programs by incrementally appending and freezing code blocks. It combines depth-calibrated, credit-guided backtracking with multi-trajectory exploration to reduce dependence on early decisions and limit redundant exploration. The generated programs can be used directly for online feature extraction without further LLM calls, decoupling offline feature discovery from online computation. Experiments show that LLM-BlockFE provides effective complementary features for structured prediction models and achieves the highest AUC in the main experiments. Ablation and generalization experiments further support the contributions of the individual design components and the applicability of the generated features across different downstream models. In five real-world financial risk management applications, post-deployment monitoring shows KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over existing manually designed strategies. These results suggest that generating inspectable, executable feature programs offline offers a viable approach to leveraging long text information in industrial prediction systems.
blocks.zh: 我们建议LLM-BlockFE,它从无结构的长文本中制定构造,作为可执行程序的离线搜索. 该方法通过递增附加和冻结代码块来构建特征程序. 它结合了深度校正,信用导回溯和多轨探索,以减少对早期决定的依赖并限制冗余探索. 所生成的程序可以直接用于在线特征提取,而无需再进行LLM调用,从在线计算中解开离线特征发现. 实验显示LLM-BlockFE为结构化预测模型提供了有效的互补特征,并实现了主要实验中最高的AUC. 通缩和通缩实验进一步支持了单个设计组件的贡献以及生成的特征在不同下游模型中的可适用性. 在5个现实世界的财务风险管理应用程序中,部署后监测显示,KS比现有手工设计的战略提高了0.02至1.56个百分点。 这些结果表明,将可检查的、可执行的功能程序下线,为在工业预测系统中利用长文本信息提供了一个可行的办法。

blocks.en: A.1. Dataset Details
blocks.zh: A.1. 数据集细节

blocks.en: Table 4 summarizes all datasets used in our evaluation. The public datasets are primarily derived from open platforms such as Kaggle, while the private industrial datasets are provided by Qfin Holdings. Since high-stakes applications such as financial risk control, which are the focus of this paper, are typically formulated as binary classification tasks, our evaluation focuses uniformly on this setting. To meet the training requirements of the downstream base models and rigorously quantify the performance gains achieved by our method, we specifically select and reconstruct multimodal datasets that contain both initial structured attributes and unstructured long text.
blocks.zh: 表4概述了我们评价中使用的所有数据集。 公共数据集主要出自于卡格尔等开放平台,而私营工业数据集则由克芬控股公司提供. 由于作为本文重点的金融风险控制等高吸收应用通常被制定为二元分类任务,因此我们的评价统一侧重于这一设定. 为了满足下游基础模型的培训需要并严格量化我们的方法取得的性能收益,我们特别选择并重建包含初始结构属性和无结构长文本的多式数据集.

blocks.en: Specifically, we construct the CFPB-Timely dataset from the publicly available CFPB Consumer Complaint Database. This dataset records detailed consumer complaints about various financial products, along with the companies’ handling statuses. For our task, we use the “complaint narrative” as the unstructured input and whether the company responded in a timely manner as the binary prediction target. We also retain seven basic structured features available when the complaint is received, such as product type, sub-product type, and issue category. For the GossipCop dataset, we use the “news article text” as the unstructured long text input and news veracity (real or fake) as the prediction label. In addition, we extract statistical metadata associated with each news article, including the number of images, number of shares, time of dissemination, and intervals between shares, as the dataset’s initial structured attributes.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们从公开的CFPB消费者投诉数据库中构建了CFPB-Timely数据集. 这个数据集记录了消费者对各种金融产品的详细投诉,以及公司的处理情况。 在我们的任务中,我们使用“投诉说明”作为无结构化的投入,以及公司是否作为二进制预测目标及时作出反应。 我们还保留了收到投诉时可用的七个基本结构特征,如产品类型、分产品类型和问题类别。 对于GossipCop数据集,我们使用“新闻文章文本”作为无结构的长文本输入和新闻真实性(真实或假)作为预测标签。 此外,我们提取与每篇新闻文章相关的统计元数据,包括图像数量、股票数量、传播时间和股票之间的间隔,作为数据集的初始结构属性。

blocks.en: Furthermore, to evaluate the model in real-world credit risk-control applications, we include two private datasets. The Report dataset consists of call records between the company’s customer service agents and users. The Remark dataset extracts remarks about target users made by their contacts by parsing authorized address books and using data shared by third-party anti-fraud alliances. Both datasets contain de-identified text and semi-structured records, enabling a comprehensive evaluation of the model’s feature extraction capabilities on complex industrial data.
blocks.zh: 此外,为了在现实世界信用风险控制应用程序中评价该模型,我们包括两个私人数据集。 报告数据集包括公司客户服务代理和用户之间的通话记录。 Remark数据集通过解析授权地址簿并使用第三方反欺诈联盟共享的数据来提取目标用户的语句. 两个数据集都包含去识别的文本和半结构化的记录,使得能够对该模型在复杂工业数据上的特征提取能力进行全面评价.

blocks.en: Our dataset selection spans settings from small to large scale. With varied feature dimensionalities and sample sizes, this diverse collection represents a broad range of real-world scenarios and provides a robust framework for evaluating the proposed method.

blocks.en: A.3. Experimental Stability Analysis
blocks.zh: A.3. 实验稳定性分析

blocks.en: We run each method independently five times on each dataset and compute the standard deviation of test AUC to assess experimental stability. As shown in Table 6 , the standard deviations of LLM-BlockFE on Remark, Report, CFPB-Timely, and GossipCop are 0.0046, 0.0088, 0.0062, and 0.0063, respectively. The results show that variability across runs differs across datasets, with relatively greater variability on Report. Overall, its standard deviations are broadly comparable to those of the LLM-based baselines, indicating that the observed performance is not attributable to a single run.
blocks.zh: 我们在每个数据集上独立运行了5次每种方法,并计算测试AUC的标准偏差以评估实验稳定性. 如表6所示,Remark、Report、CFPB-Timely和GossipCop上的LLM-BlockFE的标准偏差分别为0.0046、0.0088、0.0062和0.0063。 结果显示,各数据集的可变性不同,报告的差异较大。 总体而言,其标准偏差与基于LLM的基线大致相当,表明所观测到的性能不能归因于一跑.
